decisions.reason: Garage door operators build on the firm's existing door systems and electromechanical capabilities, allowing it to assimilate results and improve the line.
Solid wood doors remain outside the firm's metal fabrication core, and without wood-processing knowledge the firm cannot assimilate results, so it drops the product.
The remote-control operator shares the same electromechanical knowledge as Product A, so the firm can learn from both and improve the variant.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a direct extension of existing industrial door lines, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret results and refine the product.
Combining existing glazing and insulation capabilities, this product has the highest related knowledge, enabling continuous improvement.
As a glazed industrial sectional door with dedicated market presence, it closely matches the firm's existing expertise and yields clear learning.
